question: What apparent optical band gap did the Cu2O-Ag@ACR/LF-3D monolith have?
trap: the 2.0-2.2 eV literature range for Cu2O
rendered:
Document title: Acrylic-assisted immobilization of Cu2O-Ag domains on a 3D loofah monolith for adsorption-assisted visible-light photodecolorization

The apparent optical band gap of Cu2O–Ag@ACR/LF-3D was estimated from Tauc plots of [F(R^N)hn]^2 versus hn, assuming a direct allowed transition. The apparent band gap increased following acrylic incorporation and decreased slightly after immobilization on the LF-3D scaffold. The apparent band gaps were 1.67, 2.06, and 1.99 eV for Cu2O–Ag, Cu2O–Ag@ACR, and Cu2O–Ag@ACR/LF-3D, respectively.

The answer is: 1.99 eV

Document title: ZIF-67 functionalized bacterial cellulose films for light-enhanced NaBH4-assisted catalytic reduction of nitrobenzene

The apparent optical band gap of BCZIF-67 was estimated from UV-vis DRS using the Kubelka–Munk transformation. The apparent direct optical-gap energies were obtained by extrapolating the linear regions of the [F(R)hn]^2 vs. hn plots to [F(R)hn]^2 = 0. The direct-transition Tauc plots gave apparent optical-gap energies of 5.04, 4.10 and 2.96 eV for ZIF-67, BC and BCZIF-67, respectively.

The answer is: 2.96 eV
